# emby_user (Resource)

Manages an Emby user, including policy, library/channel/device access, parental controls, and profile configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a restricted user with specific library access.
resource "emby_user" "kids" {
  name                    = "Kids"
  is_administrator        = false
  enable_remote_access    = false
  enable_content_deletion = false
  enable_all_folders      = false
  enable_all_channels     = false

  # Parental controls
  max_parental_rating = 12
  block_unrated_items = ["Movie", "Trailer", "Series"]

  # Subtitles always on
  subtitle_mode = "Always"
}

# Create an admin user with full access.
resource "emby_user" "admin" {
  name               = "admin-user"
  is_administrator   = true
  enable_all_folders = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The username.

### Optional

- `allow_camera_upload` (Boolean) Whether the user can upload from camera.
- `allow_sharing_personal_items` (Boolean) Whether the user can share personal items.
- `allow_tag_or_rating` (Boolean) Whether a single tag OR rating match is sufficient to restrict content.
- `audio_language_preference` (String) Preferred audio language code.
- `authentication_provider_id` (String) The authentication provider ID for this user (e.g., an LDAP provider ID). Defaults to the server's default provider.
- `block_unrated_items` (Set of String) Set of item types to block when unrated. Valid values: Movie, Trailer, Series, Music, Game, Book, LiveTvChannel, LiveTvProgram, ChannelContent, Other.
- `blocked_tags` (Set of String) Set of content tags to block or allow, depending on `is_tag_blocking_mode_inclusive`.
- `display_missing_episodes` (Boolean) Whether to display missing episodes in series views.
- `enable_all_channels` (Boolean) Whether the user can access all channels. Set to false to restrict to `enabled_channels`.
- `enable_all_devices` (Boolean) Whether the user can use all devices. Set to false to restrict to `enabled_devices`.
- `enable_all_folders` (Boolean) Whether the user can access all library folders. Set to false to restrict to `enabled_folders`.
- `enable_audio_playback_transcoding` (Boolean) Whether the user can transcode audio.
- `enable_content_deletion` (Boolean) Whether the user can delete content.
- `enable_content_downloading` (Boolean) Whether the user can download content.
- `enable_live_tv_access` (Boolean) Whether the user can access Live TV.
- `enable_live_tv_management` (Boolean) Whether the user can manage Live TV.
- `enable_media_conversion` (Boolean) Whether the user can convert media.
- `enable_media_playback` (Boolean) Whether the user can play media.
- `enable_next_episode_auto_play` (Boolean) Whether to auto-play the next episode.
- `enable_playback_remuxing` (Boolean) Whether the user can remux playback.
- `enable_public_sharing` (Boolean) Whether the user can share content publicly.
- `enable_remote_access` (Boolean) Whether the user can access remotely.
- `enable_subtitle_downloading` (Boolean) Whether the user can download subtitles.
- `enable_subtitle_management` (Boolean) Whether the user can manage subtitles.
- `enable_sync_transcoding` (Boolean) Whether the user can use sync transcoding.
- `enable_video_playback_transcoding` (Boolean) Whether the user can transcode video.
- `enabled_channels` (Set of String) Set of channel IDs the user is allowed to access. Only effective when `enable_all_channels` is false.
- `enabled_devices` (Set of String) Set of device IDs the user is allowed to use. Only effective when `enable_all_devices` is false.
- `enabled_folders` (Set of String) Set of library IDs the user is allowed to access. Only effective when `enable_all_folders` is false.
- `excluded_sub_folders` (Set of String) Set of sub-folder paths the user is denied access to.
- `hide_played_in_latest` (Boolean) Whether to hide played items in the 'Latest' section.
- `hide_played_in_more_like_this` (Boolean) Whether to hide played items in 'More Like This'.
- `hide_played_in_suggestions` (Boolean) Whether to hide played items in suggestions.
- `include_tags` (Set of String) Set of content tags to include (only used when `is_tag_blocking_mode_inclusive` is true).
- `intro_skip_mode` (String) Intro skip behavior. Valid values: ShowButton, AutoSkip, None.
- `is_administrator` (Boolean) Whether the user is an administrator.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the user account is disabled.
- `is_hidden` (Boolean) Whether the user is hidden from login screens.
- `is_hidden_from_unused_devices` (Boolean) Whether the user is hidden from unused devices.
- `is_hidden_remotely` (Boolean) Whether the user is hidden from remote connections.
- `is_tag_blocking_mode_inclusive` (Boolean) If false, `blocked_tags` are excluded. If true, only content matching `blocked_tags` or `include_tags` is allowed.
- `latest_items_excludes` (Set of String) Item types to exclude from 'Latest' section.
- `max_parental_rating` (Number) Maximum allowed parental rating. Omit to leave unchanged (preserves server value). Set to 0 to clear the rating limit. Set to a positive value to enforce that rating as the maximum.
- `my_media_excludes` (Set of String) Item types to exclude from 'My Media' section.
- `ordered_views` (List of String) Ordered list of home screen view IDs.
- `play_default_audio_track` (Boolean) Whether to play the default audio track.
- `remember_audio_selections` (Boolean) Whether to remember audio track selections.
- `remember_subtitle_selections` (Boolean) Whether to remember subtitle track selections.
- `remote_client_bitrate_limit` (Number) Bitrate limit for remote clients in kbps. 0 means unlimited.
- `resume_rewind_seconds` (Number) Seconds to rewind when resuming playback.
- `simultaneous_stream_limit` (Number) Maximum number of simultaneous streams. 0 means unlimited.
- `subtitle_language_preference` (String) Preferred subtitle language code.
- `subtitle_mode` (String) Subtitle playback mode. Valid values: Default, Always, OnlyForced, None, Smart, HearingImpaired.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The user ID.
